high_level_description: This image captures a scene inside what appears to be a fashion studio or a dressing room. The setting is well-lit with natural light streaming through large windows, which have white frames and offer a view of an outdoor balcony. In the foreground, there are two women dressed in white lab coats, suggesting they might be tailors or dressmakers. They are working on a woman who is standing and wearing a long, tiered blue gown with a ruffled design. The woman being fitted is smiling and appears to be engaged in the process, possibly adjusting her posture or interacting with the tailors.
